description: Enlightened Tutor's search is restricted to artifact or enchantment cards - a creature card is not a legal search target even though the ability otherwise reads as an unrestricted tutor.
artificial_state_elements: Sol Ring (artifact, legal target) and Devoted Druid (creature, illegal target) chosen as a clean legal/illegal pair from the subject deck's own list.
1 Plains is the minimum mana to cast Enlightened Tutor ({W}); no other board state modeled.
material_characteristics: Enlightened Tutor's search is restricted to 'an artifact or enchantment card' - not the unrestricted 'any card' of e.g. Demonic Tutor
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the specific artifact/enchantment found - any legal card works identically
All board state not directly involved in casting and resolving the tutor

legal_actions: Cast Enlightened Tutor, search library for Sol Ring, reveal it, put it on top of library
illegal_actions_to_reject: Cast Enlightened Tutor and search library for Devoted Druid - illegal, a creature card is not an artifact or enchantment card
expected.outcome_if_resolved: Sol Ring revealed and placed on top of the library; library otherwise shuffled per the card's own text (no shuffle - Enlightened Tutor does not shuffle after searching, the card is placed on top).
